text_block_list.name: Heart Monitor
text_block_list.text: Beep, beep, beep, beep...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(A white bed and the smell of
disinfectant. This
hospital room and
everything in it's always so
immaculate.)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(There she is, asleep in her bed... My
homeroom
teacher from elementary
school—my old mentor.)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Taking a nap, Teach?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(No response... other than the sound of
her
breathing.)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh. Well, at least you look
comfortable. Hope
you don't mind if I go
ahead and start talking.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You and I have a long history together,
don't we,
Teach?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: You were always so strict back then.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... Stop right there!

text_block_list.name: Naughty Child A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, crap. She's here! Do something
quick,
Nakayama!

text_block_list.name: Elementary School Nakayama
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I've kinda got my hands full over
here.
What's her problem?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(Back in grade school, the local kids and
I were
all a bunch of daredevils.)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(We'd do dumb crap like leaping off the
highest
places in the park, or
challenging grown-ups to
games of tag.)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(As we went about screwing around all
day, other
people kept their distance,
pretending they
didn't notice us.)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: (Except for you...)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Stop that! You're going to hurt
yourselves!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You never had a chance at catching us
running
full speed, but that never
stopped you from
trying.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Then you'd give us an earful the next
day at
school.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Why must you insist on putting
yourselves in
danger? What are you
going to do when you
eventually get
hurt?

text_block_list.name: Elementary School Nakayama
text_block_list.text:
Would you shut up already? What's it
matter to
you anyways? It's my body. I'm
free to do
whatever I want with it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Sure, waste your potential if you want.
It's a
shame though, with speed like
yours, you could
be doing something far
more thrilling.

text_block_list.name: Elementary School Nakayama
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"If you like a good adrenaline rush, you
ought to
do more nail-biting challenges.
Put those legs of
yours to some use!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: It's because of you I entered Tracen... so I could take on those nail-biting challenges you spoke of.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I stepped upon the stage where the
greatest races
unfold.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Even teamed up with a trainer who says
crazy
stuff like "let's pick a fight with the
whole world."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Teach.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I've come to think that making a gamble
is a
choice. It's a choice that can decide
outcomes for
your whole life.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: When that moment comes, I wonder how clammy my hands will get. I'll probably be flustered, overwhelmed, and confused.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...It'll be the worst feeling in the world,
and at the
same time... the best.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, Nakayama Festa begins her
training for
the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm reviewing past footage of her while
putting
together her regimen for today.
Then, a certain
clip plays on the screen...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hah. Hahaha! Go ahead, get all
complacent. I'll
make you... regret it!

text_block_list.name: French Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Ah! ...Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The video was taken before she and I
met. In it,
she's running against an
Umamusume from abroad
in an unofficial
race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Only a miracle would've given her the
win. It was
the kind of race where the
harder you ran, the
more painfully clear
it became how outmatched
you were.
choice_data_list_en: (And against someone far out of her league, no less...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But Nakayama Festa—she thrives on
adversity.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ahhhgh, shut up! Shut up, shut UP! I
can't hear
anything over how loud my
heart's pounding!
Haha, I feel so...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A thought crosses my mind as I watch
her run
unhindered by the rough turf.
Her running...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No doubt, any other trainer watching
this video
would come to the same
conclusion.
choice_data_list_en: ï¼â¦â¦That's a run that could take on the world.ï¼

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That's the Umamusume we were
hearing
about! She was trying to pick a
fight with El
Condor Pasa...
choice_data_list: ……さあ、トレーニングの準備をするか！
……さあ、トレーニングの準備をするぞー！
choice_data_list_en: ……All right, let's get ready for training!
……All right, time to get ready for training!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: The trainer's a complete newbie too, right? Do they have any idea what they're trying to do? The global stage takes serious prep.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Yo, Trainer. Why so stiff?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Don't give me those puppy dog eyes.
What's the
deal with you?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Don't tell me you're nervous because of all the reporters.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You're the one who chose to be my
trainer. The
both of us are only here
because of you.

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
Oh, isn't that El Condor Pasa over
there?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa—a racer who placed
second in the
Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe,
one of the biggest
races that determines
the world's best runner.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Why has El Condor Pasa come to watch
an
Umamusume who hasn't even
debuted yet?
choice_data_list: （つまり……世界に最も近づいたウマ娘）
choice_data_list_en: (In other words... the Umamusume who came closest to the world.)

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
She must really hate her. I would too if
my own
press conference was suddenly
interrupted... I
knew this would escalate!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ah yeah... I remember the press
conference.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You just jumped into the ring and
challenged the
champ. You know what
that means, right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It means that I'm gonna beat you
and take
those world tour plans for
myself, El.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You already had your match with the
global stars,
and you lost.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
But I've got the potential to ride the new
tour to
the top.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Heh, I did spout all of that, huh?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
It's gotta be 'cause somebody egged me
on,
though. Who could that have been
now?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hehe... What for?
choice_data_list: 責任は忘れていないよ

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I don't regret what I said. Even if I did
lose
miserably to her afterwards.

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
I see. She's the loudmouth that caught El
Condor
Pasa's eye...

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't matter who wins or loses, this
is the
kind of story that draws in loads of
hits. I'd better
get to typing.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Well, I guess, now that I've got
everyone's
attention, it's all or nothing.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. After teaming up with you, I've
been having
one heck of a time.
choice_data_list: デビュー戦もヒリついた勝負になりそうだな
デビュー戦もヒリついた勝負になりそうだね
choice_data_list_en: Looks like your debut race will be an intense showdown, too.
Looks like your debut race will be an intense showdown, too.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Now, shouldn't we get started already?
We didn't
come here to chat.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Let's not make this a typical session
either. You
get me?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I wanna make a bet. Loser owes the
winner ice
cream after lunch.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
What do you say? Bet you I can run the
final
furlong in twelve seconds.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The average time for pre-debut
Umamusume to
run 200 meters hovers
around 12.5 seconds. If
things are going
right, they can hit sub-twelve.
So...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: What the...
choice_data_list: 俺は君なら“できる”に賭けたい
私は貴方なら“できる”に賭けたい
choice_data_list_en: I want to bet that you âcanâ do it.
I want to bet that you "can" do it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You realize there's nothing to wager if
we both
bet on the same outcome,
right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ever the risk taker, Nakayama Festa and
I take
our first steps toward competing
in the Twinkle
Series!
